payload.title: Alert notification recipients are free-form: alert rule recipients and escalation-level notifyUserIds accept any strings, alert-engine copies them verbatim into AlertTriggered, and notification-service dispatches to them from a locally re-declared event type without module or site, so sensor alarms reach users without the
evidence: apps/alert-engine/src/alert/dto/create-alert-rule.dto.ts:89 (rule recipients is any optional string array, with no membership validation)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/services/alert-evaluation.service.ts:509 (rule.recipients is copied verbatim into the AlertTriggered event)
apps/notification-service/src/notification/event-handlers/alert-triggered.handler.ts:71 (notification-service re-declares the event locally, with no module or site field, :71-90)
apps/notification-service/src/notification/event-handlers/alert-triggered.handler.ts:190 (dispatch goes to the event recipients without a membership check)
payload.rule_violated: D2 and D4: an alarm of module m is delivered only to holders of module m.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-44, release R5.
